The '''AAA-2 VerboBrain''' was a [[Verbobrain/Legends|verbobrain]] model installed in the [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO series]] of [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droids]], manufactured by [[SyntheTech/Legends|SyntheTech]] during the time of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].
